correctness.rationale: Equivariance gives P(t)=M(t)P0M(-t)/(1+t²)^d. The extreme torus matrix coefficient is (-1)^(r-1) binom(d-1,r-1) and nonzero for every r=1..d, establishing two exact order-d poles. The immersion makes the linear system of derivatives basepoint-free, so generic zeros are simple by Bertini. The P1 canonical divisor forces 2(d+1)-2=2d critical zeros. All parameters represent distinct smooth projectors; finite checks are only supporting evidence.

value.rationale: The uniform ED degree across every osculating rank of a rational normal curve is a natural complete all-parameter invariant, structurally surprising because the Grassmannian rank and Plücker degrees vary. It gives a concrete exact model for recent Grassmann optimization research and distinguishes the unrestricted ED problem from the harder GD problem.
